Theorem 2 and its explanatory text require increasing bandwidth strictly slower than T^(1/4) under the stated mixing, moment, smoothness and parameter-rate conditions. Across ten indexed contexts the manuscript distinguishes stronger project Gaussian arguments, untapered fixed-horizon estimators and joint sampling laws from this inherited result. It does not attribute finite-sample calibration or arbitrary dependence validity to positive semidefiniteness.
